notes: Original PTX uses256 threads (8 NVIDIA warp32s). Native uses1024 threads (16 AMD wave64s), assigning64 FP32 accumulator values per lane without private spills.
Native LDS uses65536 total bytes. F16 uses128 K32 steps; OCP E4M3 uses64 K64 steps with unit-scaled32x32x64 MFMA.
Output slices preserve256-element rows at the original4096-element pitch. Flattening to a contiguous256x256 buffer would change the baseline memory footprint.
FP8 packed prefetch live ranges are constrained with empty tied-register inline asm; it preserves bits and emits no executable instruction.
Fused variant adds the decoded input addend to the FP32 dot product, applies SiLU using the exact binary32 log2(e) compiler idiom, then stores F16.
